block.lightworks.floodlight.tooltip.acti: Aims it where you are looking.
Colours the lens, the beam and the light it casts.
block.lightworks.floodlight.tooltip.beha: Aims where you are looking, away from the face it is mounted on.
Dims as the signal rises; a _full signal_ turns it off.
block.lightworks.floodlight.tooltip.summ: A wide _cone_ for lighting an area: bright out to _12 blocks_, dark by 20. Mount it high and aim it down.
block.lightworks.headlight.tooltip.actio: Aims it where you are looking.
Colours the lens, the beam and the light it casts.
block.lightworks.headlight.tooltip.behav: Stays lit _both ways_, dimmed by the signal.
Always lit: a Searchlight with a shorter, wider beam.
block.lightworks.headlight.tooltip.summa: A forward _beam_ for vehicles. On a moving contraption, train or Sable vehicle it lights only while _leading_, so Headlights at both ends swap over when it reverses.
block.lightworks.navigation_light.toolti: Facing your left it turns _red_, facing your right _green_, otherwise _white_.
Dims as the signal rises; a _full signal_ turns it off.
A _red_, _green_ or _white_ marker for a vehicle's port side, starboard side and stern.
block.lightworks.pan_tilt_head.tooltip.b: _Pans_ the light round, as fast as the shaft turns.
_Tilts_ the light up 6° per signal level, straight up at 15.
block.lightworks.pan_tilt_head.tooltip.s: A kinetic mount for a _Searchlight_ or _Floodlight_ placed on top of it.
block.lightworks.rotating_beacon.tooltip: Colours the lens, the beams and the light they cast.
The beams turn _as fast as the shaft_.
Lights where the beams land, like two fixed Searchlights.
Dims as the signal rises; a _full signal_ turns it off.
Two opposite _beams_ that sweep round with the shaft: a rotating warning beacon for towers, airships and trains.
block.lightworks.searchlight.tooltip.act: Aims it where you are looking.
Colours the lens, the beam and the light it casts.
block.lightworks.searchlight.tooltip.beh: Aims where you are looking. Mount it on a _Pan-Tilt Head_ to sweep it round.
Dims as the signal rises; a _full signal_ turns it off.
block.lightworks.searchlight.tooltip.sum: A long, narrow _beam_ that lights the block it points at: full out to _32 blocks_, dark by 48. Keeps landing where it points on contraptions, trains and Sable vehicles.
block.lightworks.tail_light.tooltip.beha: Glows dim red and gives a little block light.
Dims as the signal rises; a _full signal_ turns it off.
block.lightworks.tail_light.tooltip.summ: A red lamp for the back of a vehicle. On a moving contraption, train or Sable vehicle it _brightens for a second_ whenever the vehicle slows down.
block.lightworks.warning_light.tooltip.b: Dims as the signal rises; a _full signal_ turns it off.
block.lightworks.warning_light.tooltip.s: An _amber_ lamp that shines steady, blinks, pulses or flashes, and lights the world round it in the same rhythm.

lightworks.ponder.floodlight.header: Lighting an area with a Floodlight
lightworks.ponder.floodlight.text_1: Floodlights spread a wide cone: bright out to 12 blocks and dark by 20
lightworks.ponder.floodlight.text_2: Mount one high on a wall or post and aim it down to light the ground below
lightworks.ponder.floodlight.text_3: It always points away from the face it is mounted on
lightworks.ponder.headlight.text_1: Headlights light the way ahead of a vehicle
lightworks.ponder.headlight.text_2: On a moving contraption, train or Sable vehicle, only those facing the way it travels light up
lightworks.ponder.headlight.text_3: When it reverses, they swap over
lightworks.ponder.headlight.text_4: Power a Headlight with redstone before the vehicle assembles to keep it lit both ways, dimmed by the signal
lightworks.ponder.navigation_light.text_: Navigation Lights show which way a vehicle faces: red on its left side...
Each takes its colour as you place it: facing your left it turns red, facing your right green, otherwise white
Right-click with a Wrench to change it
lightworks.ponder.pan_tilt_head.header: Sweeping a light with the Pan-Tilt Head
lightworks.ponder.pan_tilt_head.text_1: A Pan-Tilt Head turns the Searchlight or Floodlight on top of it
lightworks.ponder.pan_tilt_head.text_2: Shaft rotation pans it round, exactly as fast as the shaft turns
lightworks.ponder.pan_tilt_head.text_3: An analog redstone signal tilts it up 6° per level, straight up at 15
lightworks.ponder.pan_tilt_head.text_4: Stopped, the light holds its aim and lights its spot like a fixed Searchlight
lightworks.ponder.rotating_beacon.text_1: Rotating Beacons sweep two opposite beams round
lightworks.ponder.rotating_beacon.text_2: They turn with the shaft: the faster the shaft, the faster the sweep
lightworks.ponder.rotating_beacon.text_3: Stopped, the beams hold still and light where they land, like two fixed Searchlights
lightworks.ponder.searchlight.header: Lighting a spot with a Searchlight
lightworks.ponder.searchlight.text_1: Searchlights throw a long, narrow beam and light up the block it lands on
lightworks.ponder.searchlight.text_2: The beam is at full strength out to 32 blocks and fades out by 48
lightworks.ponder.searchlight.text_3: On contraptions, trains and Sable vehicles the beam keeps landing where it points
lightworks.ponder.shared.aim: Right-click with a Wrench to aim it where you are looking. Placing it aims it the same way
lightworks.ponder.shared.dye: Right-click with a dye to colour its lens, its beam and the light it casts
lightworks.ponder.shared.redstone: Redstone dims it: the stronger the signal, the dimmer the light, and a full signal turns it off
lightworks.ponder.tag.lights.description: Lights that keep working on anything Create builds
lightworks.ponder.tail_light.text_1: Tail and Brake Lights glow dim red at the back of a vehicle
lightworks.ponder.tail_light.text_2: When the vehicle slows down or stops, they brighten for a second, like brake lights
lightworks.ponder.tail_light.text_3: This works on contraptions, trains and Sable vehicles. Placed in the world, they just glow
lightworks.ponder.warning_light.text_1: Warning Lights glow amber and give block light where they stand
lightworks.ponder.warning_light.text_2: Scroll its value panel to pick a pattern: steady, blink, pulse or flash
lightworks.ponder.warning_light.text_3: The light it casts follows the pattern too, like a redstone lamp on a clock
lightworks.ponder.warning_light.text_4: Right-click with a dye to change its colour
